title: Flat
look: Solid colours, no outline, no gradient: shapes and nothing else.

doc.essence: Pure geometry in solid colour. Volume comes only from neighbouring colours, never from light.
doc.notIt: Not soft-gradient (no gradient, no glow) and not ink (no line).
doc.shapes: No outline: separate parts with different roles, or they merge.
doc.colour: The character's palette, lifted 12 % towards white.
doc.eyes: Solid dots, no shine; cheeks faintly visible.
pitfalls: Two touching parts in the same colour become one blob: give one a darker role.
